scope: Gameplay acceptance is tracked separately from general beta readiness. Deterministic engine proof is not labeled as live multiplayer proof, and route/RPC reachability is not labeled as play-to-completion proof. Player-count limits are only recorded as exact when current shipped source or deterministic acceptance grounds them; unknown backend-owned limits remain explicitly unknown.

games.deterministic_evidence: check-toepen-gameplay-matrix-v792.mjs plays the shipped engine through completion at every supported player count and covers fold/stake/undo behavior.
games.live_evidence: Historical controlled Friends/Family backend write proofs cover authenticated Toepen persistence, idempotency, scope isolation and cleanup; this is not reclassified as a full browser multiplayer playthrough.

games.deterministic_evidence: check-boerenbridge-gameplay-matrix-v792.mjs exercises the shipped 18-round cycle, dealer rotation, special rounds, bid restriction, scoring and running totals for every supported player count.
games.live_evidence: Historical controlled production proof covers authenticated persistence/vault contracts; no claim is made that every player-count combination has been played live in separate browsers.

games.deterministic_evidence: check-beerpong-gameplay-matrix-v792.mjs validates both shipped formats, player uniqueness, cup bounds, unique winner and valid submission boundaries.
games.live_evidence: Historical controlled production save proof exists; it is not treated as a full multi-device match playthrough.

minimum_evidence.identity_arguments: session_token text, session_token_input text, game_id_input uuid, site_scope_input text

games.deterministic_evidence: check-pikken-pik-conversion-v790.mjs protects bid ordering and pik conversion, while check-pikken-live-viewmodel-v792.mjs executes shipped live-view helpers for dice ordering, bid labels, winner detection, phase normalization, viewer membership and completion/abandonment handoff wiring. This still does not claim backend play-to-completion.
games.live_evidence: check-live-game-flows.mjs can create, join, ready, start and destroy a controlled two-player Pikken room when two explicit session tokens are supplied. Separately, read-only production catalog evidence records the deployed exact start-RPC definition fingerprint in backend-rpc-provenance.json.
games.remaining_gap: The exact checked-in Pikken start RPC and its observed deployed definition explicitly reject fewer than two players, grounding the minimum at 2. No authoritative checked-in room/join constraint currently proves a maximum player count, so the maximum remains unknown and must not be inferred from two-player startup success.

minimum_evidence.identity_arguments: room_code_input text, session_token text, session_token_input text, site_scope_input text

games.deterministic_evidence: check-paardenrace-engine-v792.mjs covers shipped card parsing, four-horse progress, ten gates, draw accounting, ready/wager summary and winner summary; check-paardenrace-live-viewmodel-v792.mjs executes shipped live helpers for race logs, player/ready/winner presentation, host kick boundaries, nomination targeting, the two-player live-state sanity guard and close/leave handoff wiring. This still does not claim backend play-to-completion.
games.live_evidence: check-live-game-flows.mjs can create/join a two-player room, select distinct suits, verify wagers, ready, start countdown and disband the controlled room when two explicit session tokens are supplied. Separately, read-only production catalog evidence records the deployed exact start-RPC definition fingerprint in backend-rpc-provenance.json.
games.remaining_gap: The exact checked-in Paardenrace start RPC, its observed deployed definition and the shipped lobby all explicitly reject starts below two players, grounding the minimum at 2. No authoritative checked-in room/join/schema constraint proves a maximum human room size, and the four horse suits are race entities rather than evidence of a four-human maximum.

games.deterministic_evidence: v792b-v792h transition, rule, persistence, roem-wrapper and hidden recovery-hand guards are covered by static and real-PostgreSQL proofs.
games.live_evidence: The frontend/live routes are healthy, but v792b-v792h production SQL application is a separately authorized consequential action and has not been represented as deployed.
games.remaining_gap: After explicit production SQL authorization and application, run the dedicated controlled Online Klaverjas live-write smoke before upgrading live gameplay status.
